column1: # Names of the common USB Wi-Fi and Bluetooth chips, for archr-usb-advisor.
# Whether a chip works is never written here: the image build checks the
# drivers and firmware it really ships (archr-usb-advisor gen).
#        name of every ID the module claims; a folder stands for the files
#        a driver declares only as placeholders
#   id   <vid:pid>    <name>  <kind>  <bands>   a name for one ID (wins over mod)
#        offered as "works in this image" when one of the modules is there
#        with all the firmware it declares, or with the files listed here
#        when the module declares many (btrtl covers every Realtek chip)
# kind: wifi, bt or wifi+bt. bands: 2.4, 2.4+5 or bt. Fields are TAB-separated.
